boundary: Authentic public sources ground lifecycle, visual grammar, structured schemas, governance, and deposit metadata only; they do not describe this centre case or a publication-release disposition.

sources.title: Small changes, big gains: A curriculum-wide study of teaching practices and student learning in undergraduate biology
sources.bounded_use: Supplies the authoritative article state, figure panels, captions, results prose, cohort descriptions, visible effect-size geometry, uncertainty whiskers, and stable figure DOIs for a future panel-level reconciliation.

sources.title: S1 File: Conceptual inventory scores for all matched pre- and post-tests
sources.bounded_use: Provides section-keyed term, course level, pre-score, and post-score observations that underlie the article's standardized learning-gain figures and can be joined to classroom observations through unique.section.

sources.title: S2 File: COPUS observation data
sources.bounded_use: Provides raw observations and the summarized classroom percentages used to classify teaching profiles and explain the point positions and group-work encodings in the article figures.

sources.title: Recommendations for the Conduct, Reporting, Editing, and Publication of Scholarly Work in Medical Journals
sources.publisher: International Committee of Medical Journal Editors
sources.bounded_use: Supplies external authority for final approval of the version to be published, corresponding-author responsibility, correction/version archiving, citation to the latest version, uncertainty reporting, software-version disclosure, and persistent dataset identifiers.

sources.title: Dataset for Physical Fitness Intervention Study in Higher Vocational College (400 Samples)
sources.bounded_use: Provides a concrete public-deposit object with cohort coding, explicit measurement units, a DOI-level record identity, a concept DOI, a dated release, a file-level UUID, and an inventory that can seed repository-version authority and stale-state checks.

sources.title: ManyClasses 1: Assessing the generalizable effect of immediate versus delayed feedback across many college classes
sources.bounded_use: Supplies an accepted-manuscript state for an authentic 38-class, multi-institution education study, with class- and condition-level estimates, posterior intervals, moderator plots, cohort definitions, and a stable preprint DOI distinct from the later version-of-record DOI.
